skills.description: Use this skill when rewriting, humanizing, or quality-gating Chinese web-novel (网文) chapters that must pass strict automated gates before platform upload (e.g. 番茄小说 / Fanqie). Covers the four-gate validation (字数 2800到3000、禁字禁词、硬红线、AI痕迹、对话率≥35%、近义复述=0), the de-AI humanization rewrite rules (提对话率、破节奏、show-not-tell、人物嗓音差异化、生活毛边), and the team-lead package-plus-independent-recheck workflow. Bundles all validation scripts so the gates can be run deterministically.
skills.description_zh: 用于中文网文章节的人类化改写与硬闸门校验：自动检测字数、禁字禁词、硬红线、AI 机械痕迹、对话率、近义复述，辅助通过平台 AI 检测。
